summary: Extends the BGP Flow Specification mechanism of RFC 8955 to IPv6 traffic. It defines IPv6-specific encodings for describing traffic flows to filter or rate-limit, and updates the IANA Flow Spec Component Types registry accordingly.

eli5.summary: The same shared filter-rule system for routers, now taught to describe the newer kind of Internet addresses, too.

questions: how to filter ipv6 traffic using bgp flow specification
